content: Mature vulnerability triage workflow distinguishes false positive (not exploitable in this context at all) from accepted risk (real vulnerability, consciously not remediated now, with documented rationale). CI gate blocks new findings >= HIGH unless present in an allow/suppression list; a designated reviewer must confirm non-reachability or compensating control before adding an entry, and the entry links to a review record. Decision outcomes: fix now / fix in normal cycle / monitor / accept risk / false positive. External signals (EPSS, KEV, CVSS vector) plus internal context (asset exposure, reachability) inform severity beyond raw CVSS.
